The cause-wise analysis of deaths due to other causes revealed that 29.0%, 27.4%, and 6.6% deaths in 53 cities were due to ‘Sudden Deaths’ (18,952), ‘Traffic Accidents’ (17,911), and ‘Falls’ (4,323) respectively.
